name: Donnie Darko
venue: The Roxy Cinema, 5 Park Road, Miramar, Wellington
long_description:
Details

Directed by Richard Kelly

Starring Jake Gyllenhaal, Mary McDonnell, Patrick Swayze, Jena Malone, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Holmes Osborne, Daveigh Chase

25th Anniversary

--- During the presidential election of 1988, a teenager named Donnie Darko sleepwalks out of his house one night and sees a giant, demonic-looking rabbit named Frank, who tells him the world will end in 28 days. When Donnie returns home, he finds that a jet engine has crashed into his bedroom. Is Donnie living in a parallel universe, is he suffering from mental illness - or will the world really end? ---

FEAST YOUR EYES is now at capacity, so you can now only purchase standard $15 admit tickets.

Upgrade your ticket to the FEAST YOUR EYES (FYE) experience which includes themed drink and dessert.

At Feast Your Eyes, cinephiles and foodies will be treated to a movie and food experience in the cinema at the perfect after dinner event!

Admit only tickets are $15, but you can upgrade to a Feast Your Eyes tickets for $45. All Feast Your Eyes tickets include a themed dessert* and cocktail to enjoy during the film.

The upstairs bar will open at 7:00pm for cocktail and dessert collection. The pre-show kicks off at 7:25pm and the feature begins at 7:35pm.

*No dietaries catered for.

Presented in 4K

Please note this is the original theatrical cut of the film that was released in cinemas back in 2001. It will differ slightly to other home releases of the film.
